remarks: Experience breathtaking city views and unforgettable sunsets from this spacious high-rise condo in the heart of Stamford! This inviting 1-bedroom, 1-bath home features the perfect layout for both relaxing and entertaining. Step out onto your private balcony and take in the skyline views - the perfect spot for your morning coffee or evening unwind. Located in a secure, gated building with 24-hour security, two elevators, and assigned parking, this property offers both comfort and peace of mind. The HOA delivers exceptional value, covering heat, hot water, gas cooking, sewer, snow removal, cable, on-site property management, access to the fitness center, and a swimming pool - making for truly low-maintenance living. Enjoy a prime Stamford location just minutes from vibrant restaurants, nightlife, shopping, and Tully Health Center. This home offers the perfect combination of convenience, amenities, and city lifestyle!
